categories.name: Cisco Networking & Infrastructure
categories.description: Enterprise routing, switching, data center, and network automation training tracks leading to globally valued Cisco certifications.

courses.title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA 200-301)
courses.prerequisites: Basic computer literacy; no prior networking experience strictly required.
courses.target_audience: Prospective network engineers, system admins, IT support staff, and fresh graduates.
key_topics: Network fundamentals (OSI, TCP/IP, IP addressing & subnetting IPv4/IPv6)
Network access, VLANs, trunking, and EtherChannel
IP connectivity, OSPF routing, routing tables, and gateway redundancy
IP services (DHCP, DNS, NAT, SNMP, NTP)
Security fundamentals (port security, ACLs, wireless security)
Automation, programmability, REST APIs, and software-defined networking
courses.special_promo: Includes Free RHCSA (Red Hat Linux) training bundle.

courses.title: Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP Enterprise)
courses.prerequisites: CCNA knowledge or 1-2 years networking experience.
courses.target_audience: Senior network engineers, network administrators, and system architects.
key_topics: Advanced routing (BGP, advanced OSPF, EIGRP, route manipulation)
Enterprise wireless architectures, QoS, and high availability
Network security, VPNs (DMVPN, IPsec), and segmentation
SD-Access, SD-WAN, and Cisco DNA Center automation with Python

courses.title: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE Enterprise / Data Center / Security)
courses.prerequisites: Substantial enterprise networking background and CCNP-level proficiency.
courses.target_audience: Principal network engineers, senior solutions architects, and technical directors.
key_topics: Complex enterprise infrastructure design, deployment, and optimization
Multi-protocol routing architectures, MPLS, and deep troubleshooting
Hands-on mock lab scenarios aligned with the 8-hour CCIE lab exam
